# API Requirements Checklist: Website Booking Write and Public Error Contract

**Purpose**: Unit tests for requirements writing on guest booking write and public error kinds
**Created**: 2026-08-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are required booking fields specified (name, phone, gender, condition, service, branch, date, time)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Are Friday and past dates specified as validation (no insert)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the three error kinds (validation, rate-limit, server-error) specified for public methods? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is guest-without-token success specified for the booking write? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK005 Is “stricter than catalog reads” quantified as 10 per 60 seconds for writes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK006 Is Patient reuse keyed on mobile number? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Does “no new DocType” stay consistent with Patient + Patient Appointment? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Constitution II]
- [ ] CHK008 Do empty catalog lists remain `[]` rather than a validation error? [Consistency, Spec §US3 AC3]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK009 Are missing-field and Friday-date non-insert scenarios specified? [Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK010 Is implausible email specified as a block, not a silent drop? [Coverage, Spec §US2 AC3]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Is unknown service unit specified as omit-rather-than-fail when the appointment can still be created? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Is missing Appointment Type / Practitioner specified as server error rather than a new DocType? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional / Auth

- [ ] CHK013 Is permission bypass specified for Guest Patient and Appointment insert? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK014 Are HTML stack traces forbidden on guest responses? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
